howToUse:
1. Drag & drop or upload your image into the source area.
2. The system will automatically extract the dominant colors into a palette.
3. Hover over the image preview to pick specific pixel colors interactively.
4. Click any color to instantly copy its HEX code to your clipboard.
features:
• Instant Processing
• Interactive Hover Picker
• Instant Copy to Clipboard
